notes.title: Dev Update + Christmas Renders
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays everyone!

The next update is going well but I wanted to ask you guys directly what you wanted to see next? If you have played the latest update then you know about the situation the player is now in. 

Would you like the next update to focus on more free roam content with the girls? Or would you prefer to see more story content? Or perhaps maybe even a mix? 

I already do have a list of things planned but I'd like to do my best to keep you all happy and engaged so I don't mind putting my ideas on the back burner for now if it means giving you guys what you want.

Let me know in the comments or in the game's steam discussion page: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536490/discussions/

Write all your thoughts there and I'll see how I can add them into the game.

Also if you are enjoying the game please consider leaving a review on the steam store page. The more reviews we get, the higher the game gets ranked which will lead to more updates!

Now then, looks like the family got together to take some Christmas pictures! Nadia and Isabella didn't seem to be too much in the Christmas mood!

notes.title: Update News!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Just updating you to know that the next update is coming soon. 

We had some major PC upgrades and changed/added new things to our system. 

This way we'll be able to come back with a bang.

Slight changes to the next update. Now rather than just adding the Allies system, we're also adding a little extra story content with our new system. The new story content will focus on Elena's storyline a little.

ETA for the next update should be sometime early next month! 

Thanks for bearing with us!

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/0N5TYpz.jpeg

Hey guys! Hope you're all enjoying the game. 

Time for a weekly dev update. 

The next big update is one I've been planning for a while. This update is going to focus on the allies and their content. I want to really flesh out the different factions so that players can feel unique in what choice they choose.

Each ally is going to have their own loyalty quests, all at different levels of difficulty. These quests are not mandatory of course, you can do them only if you want to. 
That said, completing the loyalty quests will give you access to some unique items and scenes.

I've got the entire update planned out, and I've even included some events that I had not originally planned to have in the game at all. I'm really excited to bring them forward into the game.

Thanks so much for supporting me guys and remember to let me know what you think.

If you want to suggest an idea to me:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536490/discussions/0/4139437808174576261/

Thanks guys!

notes.title: 1988 - Major Update #1
notes.notes:
The first major update is now here!

- You can now enter every building in Meluga City 
- Lekker City can now be unlocked and accessed
- Many new characters
- Voiced NSFW scenes
- You can now take characters on dates
- Prison location added in Teruca City
- Completely new route with Lila in Lekker City
- Players can now revisit certain scenes
- Many new NSFW scenes
- Continued Mary Storyline

Minor Updates:
 - Players can now hire men in larger quantities 
- Fixed minor errors
- Added scene to know when you have reached the end of a route
- Alexander's mother can be accessed in the prison (If captured)


Hope you guys have fun and enjoy your time in Teruca!

If you have any suggestions, remember to let me know here! - https://steamcommunity.com/app/2536490/discussions/0/4139437808174576261/

If you enjoy the game, please leave a review to help us grow!
